Ava (marketing): quick sync — finalizing launch for micro-infer-refapp-kit next Tue. Need: launch post draft, benchmark narrative, 45m webinar, inbound routing, and two tutorial tracks. Who can own which pieces?
Diego (growth): I can own the launch post + social snippets. What are the 2–3 benchmark messages we want to lead with?
Maya (devrel): I'll own the tutorials and the reference app PR. Which runtimes should we show — python client + docker image? Node examples as optional?
Raj (eng): Recommend Python + our rust-backed client for perf section. We'll ship a prebuilt Docker and a small kv-cache demo. Benchmark target: p95 < 120ms on 4k tokens for the streaming demo, and cost-per-call <= $0.015 at our typical batching.
Sam (product): Messaging: emphasize reproducible benchmark + cost transparency. Call out 2x throughput vs baseline model X in the narrative. Diego, weave that into the post.
Diego (growth): Got it. I need the raw bench runs and a short exec summary (one sentence + one metric). Raj, can you drop the commands and a quick summary?
Raj (eng): Pasting minimal repro and flags: ```bash
./bench --model micro-quant --seq 2048 --concurrency 8 --warmup 100 --runs 100 
# outputs: p50=45ms p95=118ms throughput=560 tok/s cost_est=$0.0146/call
```
Raj (eng): Summary: steady-state p95 ~118ms, stable KV cache speedup ~1.8x on conversational prefix reuse.
Maya (devrel): For tutorials I'm planning: 1) Quickstart (5-min): spin up docker, call example, get a reply. 2) Deep dive (30-min): integrate client, show caching, measurement script and how to reproduce the bench. I'll include a short eval harness.
Ava (marketing): Webinar plan — Tue 11am PT, 45 minutes (25m demo, 15m Q&A, 5m CTAs). Can ops create registration link + inbound tag mapping so we can auto-route enterprise leads?
ops-bot: Registration page created: https://forms.gle/abc123 — tags set: enterprise, midmarket, hobbyist. Inbound flow created: marketing/inbound -> sales-routing lambda.
Diego (growth): Webinar CTA ideas: 'Try Dedicated free trial' + 'Clone the refapp repo' + schedule a sales demo. Will draft slide deck.
Sam (product): Add one slide with reproducible bench steps and a table of unit economics (tokens, latency, cost) so PMs can justify.
Maya (devrel): Opening PR now for tutorial + examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/micro-infer-refapp/pull/12 — will add screenshots and short GIFs.
Diego (growth): I'll draft the blog post by Friday and ping for a review. Ava, can you assemble the launch checklist and approvals?
Ava (marketing): Yes — I'll assemble checklist, add legal/compliance check, and schedule a dry run Tuesday morning. Sharing final copy tomorrow. :rocket:
